_what: Captured host-load observation taken by the orchestrator. A load sample is not reproducible after the fact, so it is recorded here as a dated artifact rather than as a re-runnable measurement. STATUS section 2.9.55 cites these figures.
ruling: Absolute timing measurements taken under this load carry an uncontrolled covariate and are quarantined on arrival. Correctness measurements (violation censuses, battery arms) are slowed but not invalidated.
